description:
Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F00743924
Sheriff’s File # 26000908
PLAINTIFF – Nationstar Mortgage LLC vs:
DEFENDANTS- Cynthia L. Fornicola; John Fornicola;,
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 6th day of July, 2026
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Middletown Township, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Lot and Block: Lot 12, Block 349 Tax Map of Township of Middletown
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
94 Center Avenue, Middletown Township, NJ 07737, with a mailing address of 94 Center Avenue, Leonardo, NJ 07737
Dimensions: Approximately: 50x125
Upset Price: Approximately: $508,942.93 and any additional sums as ordered by the court
Occupancy Status: Unknown
Nearest Cross Street: Ridgewood Avenue
Beginning at a stake at the southerly side of Center Avenue, said stake being distant 146.25 feet easterly from the intersection of the southerly line of Center Avenue and the easterly line of Ridgewood Avenue and from said point and place of beginning running: thence (This concise description does not constitute a legal description. A copy of the full legal description can be found at the Office of the Sheriff.)
Pursuant to a tax search of 04/15/2026; 2026 Qtr 2 Due: 05/01/2026 $2,469.02 Open added assessments: Pending Added/Omitted Assesment from date of certificate of occupancy or assessor's inspection of property Sewer: Township of Middletown Sewerage Authority Acct: 33928 0 03/01/2026-05/31/2026 $140.00 Open and due 05/31/2026 $489.75 Open Plus Penalty; Owed in arrears Water: Private-NJ American Water Co. General Remark: 2026 Taxes will reflect change in assessed value. Subject to Deed restriction recorded 7/22/19 book 9358, page 7854 prohibiting a mulit-family use.
For sale information, please visit Auction.com at www. Auction.com or call (800) 280.2832.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $501,555.79.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: April 23, 2026
Frenkel Lambert Weiss Weisman & Gordon, LLP
53 Gibson Place
Bay Shore, NY 11706
